evidence: Wealthnow Free hard-caps at its included monthly credit grant with no overage. Fundamentals and Market Data are included on Free; price_snapshot costs 1 credit.

The Free fundamentals/price_snapshot route returns last trade price, independent trade event time (`as_of`/`time`), bid, ask, sizes, and independent quote event time (`quote_as_of`) while the exchange is in session, plus freshness/staleness fields. This is sufficient technical schema for strict G9-B subject to same-run RTH freshness <=60s and quote/trade skew <=15s.

The dedicated Starter+ streaming quotes route is explicitly documented as consolidated top-of-book NBBO with best bid/ask, venue IDs, and quote timestamps; trade ticks are a separate stream. This proves Wealthnow has an NBBO-capable upstream path.

However the Free price_snapshot reference and Market Data guide do not label its bid/ask as NBBO, consolidated, SIP, UTP, CTA, or as sourced from the Starter+ NBBO stream. The response source label `market-data:v2-snapshot` is an internal label, not primary-source lineage proof. Therefore strict G9-A remains unproven for the Free route.

Wealthnow officially supports REST Bearer/API-key access, a hosted MCP endpoint, OAuth agent connections including ChatGPT custom MCP, SDKs, and agent use. Therefore canonical scheduler callability is technically implementable without exposing a key in repository files. D still requires the actual canonical scheduler credential to be configured and a same-run RTH probe.

Wealthnow API keys can be created with no expiry and lower per-key request limits. Free workspaces can hold multiple keys. This supports a dedicated read-only market-data scheduler key, but no credential is currently configured in XRAY.
